pillar_reactions.evidence: The pillar was tailored specifically to his back - 'Trevor's also going to give you a mobility routine specific to your spine to like your lower back area' - and the reaction was agreement without questions: 'yeah, you summarize it very well, I mean, yeah, that would be great to have.'
Delivered around the when-what-how-much frame and the protein gap, and answered 'yeah absolutely yeah'. No questions, no pushback, no enthusiasm.

The only question he asked about the product on the whole call came here, and it was about whether the coaching would actually be reachable from Hungary: 'I was wondering just where Trevor is seated? I mean, where is he living?' The rep answered with Sacramento and an anecdote about response times rather than a stated service level.

anchors.raw: I saw some videos online, Facebook, Reels, whatever, and YouTube with some kettlebell sessions... and that's what I also saw Trevor's videos, and then I was curious and just bought some kettlebell bells itself, and then I started to do the exercise
anchors.competitor: free short-form content from Trevor and from a second creator he names as Rokas
anchors.note: Third instance in this batch of Primal's own free funnel working as a substitute, and the strongest one because it is producing results: two months in he reports visible change and feeling stronger. He also said outright that he would carry on alone regardless - 'If anything happens after today, I would, of course, continue and buy new stuff and watch more videos.'

anchors.raw: after a limit or a level, you know, it's hard to have a progress alone, let's say, because there's no checkup, no feedback
anchors.note: The counterweight to the free-content anchor and the reason he bought. He has already found the ceiling of the free path and named it himself as missing feedback and technique verification, which is exactly what the one-to-one tier sells.

anchors.raw: we have an investment of 6k USD, which is around 5.2 thousand euros
anchors.note: A dollar price landing in euros in Hungary, on a prospect who keeps everything in savings and had close to nothing in his current account at month end. He met no price resistance at all, but the mechanics of paying meant $5,900 of a $6,000 close walked out of the call uncollected.

unmet_demand.want: Actual treatment for a year of sacroiliac joint pain. He diagnosed the gap himself: 'I have to do other things than kettlebell also, some stretches and some medical, let's say, trainings, because I've been researching this kind of pain... it's really hard to get rid of it, because it's a joint pain between the bones.'
unmet_demand.why_unmet: The programme is coaching, not clinical care, and there is no referral step and no clearance requirement. Rather than the gap being acknowledged, the prospect's own accurate assessment was argued against with a testimonial about another client's back pain, and he ended the call expecting the programme to reduce it.

unmet_demand.want: A realistic sense of what is achievable for him specifically - he raised it unprompted: 'maybe my limits are much, much different or lower than, let's say, Trevor. So maybe I will never reach that kind of shape or muscles'
unmet_demand.why_unmet: No expectation was set at any point. The response was that outcomes come down to mindset and effort - 'it can be a 20-year-old, it can also be a 70-year-old, it really doesn't matter, it just comes down to what's up in here' - which is the opposite of the individualised answer he was asking for.

unmet_demand.want: Protein sufficient for muscle gain without dairy, given twenty years of lactose intolerance
unmet_demand.why_unmet: The intolerance was volunteered and acknowledged in one line ('You can work around it') and never returned to, even though the nutrition pillar was delivered around raising protein and he currently guesses at intake with no tracking.
